dataset.method: Timestamp aging after production API enqueue. Fault drills execute with this durable backlog present; four real workers drain it after the faults recover. No claim of simultaneous fault injection during mixed enterprise traffic.

scope: Exact application image, dependency-complete ZIP and Composer distribution on each supported engine. Drills run in an isolated database with the production classmap and testing fixture configuration; the separate production deployment lanes exercise production policy and the web image together.

drills.client_error: Terminated worker process; no completed settlement until its replacement owns the fence.
drills.retryability: After wall-clock lease expiry; stale lease cannot settle.
drills.audit_evidence: JUnit asserts persisted job attempts, lease token and exactly one durable effect.
drills.metric_alert: kumwe_workers_registered / KumweNoLiveWorker; queue age also rises while no worker drains.
drills.invariant: One durable effect and one completed settlement under the successor fence.
drills.recovery: Supervisor restarts worker after the eight-second lease expires.

drills.client_error: Permanent connection loss exits nonzero; severed session leaves work pending rather than completed.
drills.retryability: At-least-once after connection recovery and five-second lease expiry; no invented settlement.
drills.audit_evidence: JUnit asserts reserved/pending/completed transitions, attempt counts and absence of fabricated failed-job rows.
drills.metric_alert: Database readiness and queue age / KumweReadinessFailing and KumweJobQueueStalled.
drills.invariant: Lost settlement never records completion; replacement records the actual successful attempt.
drills.recovery: Restore the network relay and restart the worker; replace a severed session in place.

drills.client_error: Sign-in fails closed with Redis unreachable; the non-authoritative settings cache falls back to SQL.
drills.retryability: After Redis path restoration and client/process replacement.
drills.audit_evidence: JUnit asserts readiness false, authentication refusal and the cache-degradation warning.
drills.invariant: No uncounted authentication attempt; authoritative settings remain readable.
drills.recovery: Restore Redis connectivity and replace the failed connection.

drills.client_error: Occupied permits refuse excess claims without blocking unrelated replicas or tenants.
drills.retryability: After permit release or lease expiry.
drills.audit_evidence: JUnit asserts real independent connections, killed-holder recovery, lease counts and fair tenant turns.
drills.metric_alert: Queue depth, oldest age and live workers / KumweJobQueueStalled and KumweNoLiveWorker.
drills.invariant: Shared concurrency ceiling holds; a noisy tenant does not starve the remaining backlog.
drills.recovery: Other replicas skip busy permits and drain eligible tenants; dead holders expire.
